For the Respondent/s : Mr. Bal Mukund Prasad Sinha, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 4 09-04-2025 Learned counsel for the appellant, Ms. Priya prays for and is allowed to implead the informant as respondent no. 2 in course of the day.
2. The present appeal has been filed:
against the Judgment dated 10.10.2023 and Sentence dated 17.10.2023 passed by Additional District and Session Judge VI Special Judge POCSO Bhojpur Ara in POCSO Case No. 29 of 2023 arising out of Ara Nagar P.s Case No. 178 of 2022 whereby and whereunder Additional District and Session Judge VI cum Special Judge POCSO Bhojpur Ara has convicted the appellant under section 363, 376 of Indian Penal Code and 4 of POCSO Act and sentences under section 363 of I.P.C. 4 years rigorous imprisonment and fine of Rs. 5000 and in default of payment of fine 3 month rigorous imprisonment and appellant further sentence under Section 4 of POCSO Act 10 years Patna High Court CR.

3. The appeal stands admitted and the learned APP was directed around one year ago on 16.05.2024 to file written objection but the same has not been filed.
